reviews.title: Great Upgrade from My Trident Royal's!
reviews.comment: Great Value for the performance that they offer. Very pleased with the performance over my previous RAMM and you can't deny that the Aesthetics are killer as well. Definitely worth it! Edit- After a few weeks of operation I started having trouble with games crashing and spontaneous black screening. At first I thought it was a graphics card issue but a couple days later I noticed one of my memory sticks RGB was stuck on default rainbow and wasn't syncing with the rest of case. Two days later that stick died and now the other is stuck on default rgb. I am running my 10 yr old corsair vengeance at the moment and my computer has not even had a hiccup. Kind of disappointed but hoping it was just a bad set of ram and that TeamGroup will take care of me. So far the support team have been helpful.

reviews.title: Great Ram at a Good Price.
reviews.comment: I perchesed 2 Sticks of TeamGroup T-Force Delta RGB DDR4 16Gb (2 x 8 GB) 3600MHz to test in 2 new mother boards that I was using to upgrade 2 of my PC's from what had been using for over 14 years The FX-8350 8 Core @ 4.0 GHz! That was working fine but I needed to get up to date! To the new AMD Ryzen 7 5800X 4.7 GHz So I tested both new setups with this RAM and then eventually went to 32Gb in both systems and both have been working great for almost 2 years! No errors or any problems at all! I always ran main brands of memory but it was ether unavailable or to expensive! So for now on I will be using TeamGroup T-force RAM!  Thank You,  Rick...
reviews.author: Rick Dahmer

reviews.title: Vibrant RGB, works.
reviews.comment: Casual PC Gamer. Replaced my old sticks and it went in without a hitch. RGB lighting will not always immediately come on and may need to be activated and adjusted with your computer's lighting control software (Mine is Aura Creator for ASUS). As always make sure your computer supports the RAM sticks before purchase and installation. Sticks are best installed in the original slots unless already occupied with the desired sticks. These sticks aren't as flimsy as the stock ones so putting light pressure for installation was fairly easy and worry free, even for a novice like myself. There was hardly a noticable temperature difference after installation, even with the RGBs on. (PC: ASUS ROG G10DK).
reviews.author: James Eximiris
